title: Hawaiian Chicken came out great
text:
Hawaiian Chicken came out great. This is a great crock-pot. The price is kind of high. Depending on what you are cooking, the stirrer can come in really handy. With all of the great new ideas for what to cook in a crock-pot the stirrer may prove to be a great addition.

I do find the cords are a little awkward but not too bad. You have to plug one into the other then into the outlet which is good if you don't have many outlets.

Next on the menu...salsa!

Hawaiian Chicken
2 lb chicken tenderloin chunks
1 cup pineapple juice
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/3 cup soy sauce

cook on low 6-8 hours. you can serve on rice. :)

product_metadata.title: Crock-Pot iStir Automatic Stirring Slow Cooker with 2 Removable Paddles, Stainless Steel, SCCPVP650A
description: Automatic stirring does the work for you to improve food taste, texture and appeal so you can enjoy appetizing, great-tasting meals. This Crock-Pot® Slow Cooker uses a lid-mounted stirring system to cook food more evenly with no hot spots and blend flavors during cooking so you don't have to be in the kitchen at all! It does the stirring for you. Attachments assist in stirring soups, stews, chili and more. Designed to stir in cycles and eliminate build up on sidewalls also makes clean up even easier too. If stirring is not required, lid insert can be quickly and easily switched out for a regular cooking handle. The Crock-Pot® Automatic Stirring Slow Cooker offers cooks versatility to prepare any sort of homemade dish with every possible convenience! Programmable control settings allow you to choose cooking times between 30 minutes to 20 hours. Other features include auto-shift to warm after cooking is complete and removable, dishwasher-safe, oval stoneware. 6.5 quart capacity.
